CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 28, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – January 28, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng

  Absent:  Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, City Architect; Eric D. Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES - JANUARY 14, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the January 14, 2024, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the minutes of the January 14, 2025 meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-2024-00134
  • 505 Winthrop Drive
  • Applicant: Christynn Kanai; Samantha Bryan

  1
   •  Request: This is an application for seven (7) window replacements
  on an existing 1-story single-family house.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  •  City Architect Representative Eric D. Martinez provided the Staff
  presentation.

MOTION:
  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application
  with conditions as follows:
  1) Revise the window grilles/muntins and provide only horizontal
  grilles that are evenly distributed on each sash for the four (4) new
  windows visible from the public right of way.
  2) The applicant shall revise the proposed window elevations / detail
  in response to Condition #1 and resubmit for City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-2025-00003
  • 236 West Main Street
  • Applicant: John Estrada
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story commercial building for a restaurant business known as
  ‘Chukum’.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  • City Architect Representative Eric D. Martinez provided the Staff
  presentation.

MOTION:
  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application
  with conditions as follows:
  1) Provide dimensions on the elevation that demonstrates the sign
  to be centered vertically to the arch opening and horizontally
  between the top of parapet and top of arch opening.
  2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng

  2
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Tsai

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  DRB-2023-00220
  • 235 South Curtis Avenue
  • Applicant: Henry Ho
  • Request: This is an application for new construction of a 10-unit
  10,740 SF 3-story multi-family development with 1- and 2-car garages
  at ground level, accessible by a central driveway.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  • City Architect Representative Eric D. Martinez provided the Staff
  presentation.

  MOTION:
  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows:
  1) Revise the proposed garage door color/finish to a shade of gray
  which is consistent with the building’s color palette.
  2) Provide a textured finish, such as stucco, on all privacy walls,
  retaining walls, and trash enclosure walls that are compatible with
  the building’s wall cladding material.
  3) The applicant shall coordinate with City staff on the accessible
  route from the public right of way through the landscape area, if
  required by the building code.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:07 P.M. to Tuesday,
  February 11, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  3
 ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
